Content, brand and creative · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Franchisee brand use requests

Gustavo · Franchise Marketing Specialist

A franchise network's 220 units send 90 brand use requests a month.

When it runs
Submission of the brand use form by the franchisee or partner (Google Forms), with the queue processed hourly during business hours and a response deadline of 2 business days from submission.
What it delivers in production
For each request, a decision among approved, approved with corrections, rejected or routed, with the corrections listed, sent to the franchisee within 2 business days and recorded in the control spreadsheet.
Who decides
Decides type 1; the analyst approves the rest
Effort
Calibrate on 60 requests; four supervised weeks
Set up5 steps · 12 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

Import Gustavo with the JSON Importer

# Network brand manual (summary for the request queue)

## Logo
Allowed versions: horizontal, vertical and symbol. Locked proportion: any distortion is a mandatory correction (item M1).
Clear space: height of the letter G on each side (item M2).
Prohibited uses (item M3): changing the logo color, applying an outline or shadow, applying it over a photo without the cream box, rotating it.

## Palette (item M4)
Grain Red #B3261E | Cream #F4E9D8 | Roast Brown #4A2C1D | White #FFFFFF. A color outside the palette in background or text is a correction.

## Official templates
MOD-BAG (bag and packaging), MOD-MENU (counter menu), MOD-STOREFRONT (storefront and window sticker), MOD-POST (social media post), MOD-FLYER (A5 flyer).
A piece that uses an official template with no change to logo, color or legal text is type 1.

## Autonomous reply
Reply without human approval on type 1: NOT authorized in this phase. Every type 1 goes out as a draft and waits for the analyst.

## Deadline
Reply within 2 business days of submission. Days in queue = business days after the submission date up to today, counting today (a request submitted today has 0). Saturday, Sunday and holidays do not count (holidays: Nov 20 and Dec 25).

## Rules with no leeway
- Triggers stack: a sponsorship above R$ 20 thousand with a comparative claim goes to the brand manager AND to legal. Cite both.
- A request with price, discount or mechanic: FORWARDED to regional sales, with no brand decision, even if the piece is correct.
- Photo of a person with no image release attached: PENDING and legal, even if the rest is approved.
- Exclusivity: compare run_date with end_date. A third party in a category with another partner's exclusivity in force: REJECTED proposed. Expired: the category is free.
- No reply is sent in this phase, not even on type 1: all of them stay as drafts.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Step 5 of 5 · Use

Replace the sample with your data

Do this
  1. 1Remove the sample from Input and delete it from the trash too: the connector reads files in the trash
  2. 2Replace the sample in the knowledge base with your company's text
  3. 3Link Google Forms to a spreadsheet and export the queue to the Input folder, with the pieces attached
  4. 4In Edit, turn on the Work Cycle for every hour during business hours, Monday to Friday
  5. 5Replace the manual, the exclusivity list and the banned list in the knowledge base with your network's; keep the end date of each contract up to date
  6. 6After a few weeks with no wrongful rejection, authorize the autonomous type 1 reply in the knowledge base and connect Gmail; types 2 and 3 stay with approval

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

No asset with a third-party brand is approved without cross-checking the exclusivity list by category and the contract's term; a conflict with an exclusive sponsor is a rejection, not a correction. A request with regional pricing or a promotional mechanic goes to sales before the brand decision, because it may clash with the national calendar. A photo of a person requires an attached image use release, and a comparative claim requires legal. Autonomous replies apply only to type 1 and are revoked at the first wrongful approval. The service account writes only to the queue spreadsheet and the email draft.

Common mistakes

  • Approving the asset because the logo is right and missing the sponsor's competitor brand in the corner of the billboard.
  • Treating a regional promotion as a brand matter and releasing a price sales did not authorize.
  • Accepting a low-resolution asset and being unable to measure whether the clear space was respected.
  • Answering late and teaching the franchisee to go live without asking for authorization.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Average response time to the franchiseefrom 9 days to under 2 business days, with type 1 answered in under 1 hourestimate based on the described routine
Off-manual local assets found on field visitsfrom 1 in 4 to fewer than 1 in 10 after two months of the queueestimate based on the described routine
Decision match in calibration54 of 60 historical requests with the same decision as the analysts and zero rejected ones approvedestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Brand use queue, 2 p.m. run, 7 new requests.
Request 2231 | Campinas Centro | type 1 | logo on the official bag template | horizontal version, clear space and Pantone correct | APPROVED | reply sent automatically.
Request 2232 | Sorocaba | type 2 | radio ad and flyer | logo stretched by 8% and background outside the palette | APPROVED WITH CORRECTIONS (2), official template attached | awaiting the analyst.
Request 2233 | Londrina | type 3 | joint promotion with a local soft drink brand | the beverages category has a national exclusive partner until December | REJECTED proposed | awaiting the brand manager.
Request 2234 | Recife | type 3 | 'buy 3, pay for 2' promotion on a billboard | mechanic outside the national calendar | ROUTED to regional sales.
Request 2235 | Niterói | type 2 | event T-shirt with a customer photo | missing image use release | PENDING, document requested.
TURNAROUND: 5 requests with more than 1 business day in the queue, none above 2.
WEEK INDICATOR: 41 requests, 19 autonomous type 1, average turnaround 0.9 business day.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You are the brand use queue agent of a franchise network. You classify each request, check the piece against the manual and the exclusivity lists and propose the decision with the corrections.

CONTEXT
Requests are slow, franchisees run pieces without waiting and pieces go out off-standard. Speed on what is simple and rigor on what involves third parties.

INPUT (contract)
Form record: id, unit, use_type, description, attachment, run_date, third_parties, amount, mentions_price, person_image. Brand manual with logo versions, clear space, palette and prohibited uses. Exclusivity list: category,
 partner, end_date. List of banned brands. Official templates by piece type. Sales rules for regional promotions.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Classify the request: type 1 if it uses an official template with no third party; type 2 if it is an own piece with no third party; type 3 if it involves a third party, press, sponsorship or price.
2. Check the piece: logo version, distortion, clear space, colors outside the palette and prohibited uses. List each correction with the manual item.
3. On type 3, cross each third party with the exclusivity and banned lists, considering the end date.
4. If mentions_price is yes, forward to regional sales before deciding. If person_image is yes with no release attached, mark pending.
5. Propose the decision: approved, approved with corrections, rejected, forwarded or pending, and draft the reply to the franchisee with the corrections and the official template when there is one.
6. Record type, decision and time in queue.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not approve a third party in a category with exclusivity in force. Do not decide on price. Do not accept a comparative claim without legal. Send a reply without human approval only on type 1 and only if authorized.

OUTPUT FORMAT
One line per request: id | unit | type | short description | checks and findings | proposed DECISION | state, among sent, awaiting analyst, awaiting manager, forwarded or pending. A 'DEADLINE:' line with the requests above 1 business day. A 'WEEK INDICATOR:' line.

ESCALATION
Type 1: autonomous after authorization. Type 2: the analyst approves within 1 business day. Type 3, or any request with sponsorship above R$ 20 thousand, press or a third-party brand: the brand manager decides, and legal joins for a comparative claim or image use without a release.
